summary:
The maintained bar-headless image controller and its original-operation custody remain the BAR image route. Current public routing uses the dispatch-only Native.Qualification caller on a dedicated ephemeral Ubuntu24.04 Noble guest, private repository-level JIT runner in Default group, and the exact reviewed FSBar recipe. This supersedes earlier public hosted/Ubuntu26.10 or limited-group routing descriptions, while preserving their historical evidence. The three caller files are byte-identical reviewed public templates pinned by MANIFEST.sha256. Supported deployment is a Coordination PR first, then copying those exact bytes to the private caller; branch-protection unavailability does not itself grant a direct write. Root separately selects any deployment and dispatch. The caller checks source-main ancestry and exact three-file correspondence before privileged pinned code.

The fixed Python bar_hosted_operation wrapper invokes the existing portable-workspace-image.py qualify --profile bar-headless route; no CLI upgrade or arbitrary native command is introduced. Source/runtime closure, complete recipe and output archive correspondence retain distinct identities. Fresh original operation, owned stores, deadlines, resource bounds, first-cause retention and scoped cleanup remain required; prepared source does not authorize execution or establish loaded ABI/product behavior.

Profile preparation already creates the0700 evidence directory and retains its receipt. Controls initialization now uses mkdir -p -m0700 so that existing profile-owned custody survives. An actual extracted profile-to-controls initialization control reproduces the old EEXIST failure, then verifies the fixed path preserves original receipt bytes/inode/ownership/mode and original clock. Twenty-eight affected workflow/clock controls pass. These are ordinary source controls, not a native bake. Image identities and actual tool/plugin output pins remain unfilled until a genuine admitted bake and independent readback. Full image qualification, native settlement/retirement and whole1032 acceptance remain separate.
title: Keep BAR image qualification in the maintained private caller and original custody
